title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Location: RemoteType: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.  Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.  Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.  Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.  Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.  What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;  quality comes from you.  To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Machine Learning Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us. What you'll do Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.G., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.  What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be successful in this role if you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.G., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.G., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).  Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.G., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.  Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Promotion & Growth Strategy Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows. Ensure promos align with the show's narrative hook and audience appeal.  Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field. Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms. Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams. Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies. Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions. Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.  Key Traits for Success Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

Top Skills' Details1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations. 2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development). 3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery. 3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred). 4.) Hands on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs. Job Description: Our Client is the nation's leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‐integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems. The Role We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience, strong full‐stack engineering skills, and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‐native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications. You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‐on coding and deployment automation. Key Responsibilities Enterprise System Integration Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS, NetSuite, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. Design and implement RESTful APIs, event‐driven integrations, and data‐sync pipelines. Lead integration efforts during M&A system consolidation, ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms.  AWS Engineering & Architecture Build serverless and microservices‐based applications using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, EventBridge, SNS/SQS, and related AWS services. Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns.  Full‐Stack Development Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes.  Advanced Development & Data Workflows Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce NetSuite AWS).‐performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce NetSuite AWS). Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‐scale data migrations and cross‐platform synchronization. Perform deep‐dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.  Technical Leadership & Collaboration Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‐vs‐Buy recommendations. Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies.  Qualifications Required Technical Skills 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority. Expert level AWS development experience, especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‐level AWS development experience‐driven architectures. Strong full‐stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred). Proven track record developing REST APIs, microservices, and cloud‐native applications. Hands‐on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs. Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‐scale migration tooling. Solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).  Soft Skills Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly. Strong analytical and root‐cause debugging skills. Ability to collaborate with cross‐functional business and engineering teams.  Preferred Skills Experience with EventBridge, AppFlow, or enterprise iPaaS tools. Background in M&A system consolidation or multi‐system enterprise architecture.

title: Paid Ads Qa Auditor - Global
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Paid Ads Qa Auditor - Global em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look? Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems? Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role. At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients' brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error. However, it is not a "task-ing" role, or a role where you'll be constantly told what to do - you'll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch. Key Responsibilities Include: Campaign Audit & Validation Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters  Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup  Budget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly  Tracking, Links & Technical QA Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM parameters and tracking links Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable) Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies  Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation Compare campaign execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely  Audit Documentation & Communication Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.G., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution  Audit Operations (Evolving Scope) This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits  Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts  Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)  Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards  Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment  Preferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)  Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment  Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) TikTok Ads LinkedIn Ads TradeDesk  Why Our Work Matters: Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn't enough. That's where Crisp comes in. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it's a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. About Crisp: Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp ( is the nation's fastest-growing law firm growth company. We've helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Qual será o seu papel? Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional. Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico. Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade. Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema. Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio. Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.  Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas, CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos. Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas. Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital.  Você pode se destacar se: Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant. Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards). Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware). Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM. Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce. Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade. Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops).  Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Médico Pediatra
description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;  PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.  Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.  Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA  Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);  Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo;  Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Fx Trader em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai Automation Specialist
description:

Hey, Dingus!Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines. Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments. Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines. Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production. Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head. Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately. Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask. Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time. Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.  What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.Com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred). Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs. Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures. Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations. Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding. A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs. A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.  Bonus Points Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.). Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts). Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.  Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English  If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Note: Due to the high number of applicants across roles, responses and processes will take a while.

description:

Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.  03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.  NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot.  04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for  APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Confira a oportunidade para English Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.  Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.  Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script.O que você vai fazer aqui? Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e LinkedIn, gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos. Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença. Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas. Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar. Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo.  O que buscamos? Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real. Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente. Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico. Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar. Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos.  Pontos extra se... Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou SaaS B2B para o mercado mid-market. Tem familiaridade com ferramentas como HubSpot, Salesforce ou plataformas de sales engagement (Apollo, Outreach, etc.). Fala espanhol.  O que oferecemos? Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta. Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva. Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

Nova vaga disponível para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.Js + React + Php em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Quem somos?Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.  Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação: Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração: Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados: Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend: Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança: Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps: Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.  O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.  Quais são os requisitos? Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;  Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.Js e TypeScript em produção Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;  Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web em produção;  Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem;  Experiência comfilas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);  Conhecimento deframeworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.Js;  Conhecimento empadrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);  Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código;  Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);  Habilidade paratrabalhar de forma colaborativa.  Será um diferencial: Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;  Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);  Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.  O que oferecemos? Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  6 dias de folgaanuais + folga de aniversário;  Bônus de indicação;  Bônus de equipe; Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!  Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde! Dúvidas? Fale com a gente:

title: Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes:  -  Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection  -  Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats  -  Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production  -  Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases  -  Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value  -  Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling  -  Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time  -  Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS  -  Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia. title: Ai Implementation Lead (Technical Pm For Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Ai Implementation Lead (Technical Pm For Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast.We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate\ "we have this messy thing happening in our operations\ " into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time:\ "Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\ " You don't need to write theproduction code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say\ "that wasn't in the ticket.\"You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned  In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery  We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

E aí, tudo azul por aí?A Turbi é a locadora do futuro: 100% digital, movida a tecnologia, gente boa e paixão por transformar a forma como as pessoas se locomovem. A gente abre carro pelo app (sim, sem chave!) e acredita que inovação de verdade começa com um time engajado e com liberdade pra criar. Estamos procurando uma pessoa para a posição de Desenvolvedor Backend Senior, alguém que queira acelerar com a gente nessa jornada. O seu papel por aqui: Nesta posição Desenvolvedor Backend Senior, você será protagonista na construção de sistemas robustos e de alto desempenho. O foco central será a entrega de valor através de soluções de engenharia que sustentem a escalabilidade do negócio, garantindo a satisfação dos nossos clientes e o cumprimento das metas de expansão para 2026. Mais do que entregar tarefas, a ideia é construir junto com autonomia, responsabilidade e espaço pra testar, errar e aprender. O que você vai encarar no dia a dia: Comunicação e Empatia: Capacidade de expor dificuldades e problemas de forma clara, demonstrando empatia com os desafios dos times e compreendendo demandas de áreas não técnicas. Desenvolvimento Backend: Atuar no desenvolvimento de sistemas e aplicações voltadas para o ecossistema de IoT. Apoio e Escalada: Suportar o time e outras áreas de negócio em regime de escala (escalations) durante um final de semana por mês. Padronização: Utilizar ferramentas e padrões estabelecidos pela empresa para a construção de novas soluções. Qualidade e Entrega: Realizar a entrega de sistemas, acompanhando de perto os indicadores de qualidade e a experiência de uso.  O que esperamos de você: Backend de Alta Performance: Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de serviços de alto desempenho. Kubernetes: Domínio da ferramenta sob a perspectiva de desenvolvimento. Controle de Versão: Sólidos conhecimentos em GIT. Arquitetura: Vivência sólida no desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos e escaláveis. Segurança: Experiência na disseminação e implementação de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Security by Design). Resolução de Problemas: Experiência em troubleshooting em ambiente de produção, aplicando contramedidas imediatas e desenvolvendo soluções definitivas. Soft Skills: Perfil colaborativo e focado em trabalho em equipe. Stack Principal: Domínio em GoLang, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, REST, OAuth 2.0, Swagger e ambientes Linux/Unix. Diferenciais (Bom saber): PostgreSQL, Google Cloud (Pub/Sub, Cloud Task, AppEngine), OpenID Connect, Flyway, Load Balancers, Containers, JavaScript, Curl e JIRA. Banco de Dados: Experiência prática com bancos de dados Relacionais e Não Relacionais (NoSQL).  O que a Turbi oferece pra te apoiar nessa jornada? Salário competitivo no modelo PJ, alinhado com o mercado;  Saúde em dia: plano de saúde SulAmérica pra cuidar de você. Sorriso garantido: plano odontológico Bradesco. Corpo em movimento: acesso ao Wellhub ou Totalpass pra treinar do seu jeito. TurbiFree todo mês: R$ 1.000 pra usar nossos carros como quiser. Pausa merecida: 30 dias de recesso remunerado depois de 12 meses com a gente. Parabéns com folga: Day Off no seu aniversário pra comemorar como quiser. Licença maternidade estendida: mais tempo pra viver esse momento com tranquilidade. Licença paternidade: presença garantida nos primeiros dias mais importantes. Bônus: Atrelado ao atingimento de metas da Turbi e individuais.  Nosso jeito de trabalhar: A Turbi é feita por gente real, que erra, aprende, cresce e faz acontecer. Por aqui, autonomia anda junto com responsabilidade. A gente valoriza um ambiente seguro pra falar o que pensa, construir com liberdade e ter conversas difíceis com respeito. A gente valoriza pessoas que aprendem, se desafiam e querem gerar impacto de verdade. Se viu aqui? Então se inscreve e vem com a gente transformar a mobilidade urbana!

title: Support Team Lead
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Support Team Lead em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment. We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career. In this role you will: (responsibilities) Provide end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs platforms, including issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive system monitoring. Veeva API: Collaborated with the BOT development team to provide Veeva RIM API endpoints to facilitate automation and system integration. Learning Management Coordinators: Contributed to the setup of the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite, enabling streamlined training compliance track. PleaseReview: Serve as a technical point of contact for both Standalone and Veeva-integrated PleaseReview applications, managing user access, configuration, and performance optimization and licenses management. ISI Toolbox: Support the setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, ensuring accurate installation, patching, and integration with other internal systems.  Mandatory Skills: Experience with the life science and healthcare industry. Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment. Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments. Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.G., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes. Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams. Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.  Desirable Skills: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Regulatory Operations, IT Security, QA, Validation) to meet compliance and audit readiness. Maintain comprehensive documentation, including SOPs, user manuals, knowledge base articles, and incident logs. Participate in validation testing (IQ/OQ/PQ) and periodic system reviews within GxP-regulated environments. Assist in system upgrades, patch testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to support uninterrupted business operations. Proactively identify and drive opportunities for process automation, system optimization, and user experience enhancements. Troubleshoot critical production issues, including system unavailability and data integrity issues, and propose resolutions or workarounds. Ability to replicate & diagnose issues using industry-standard tools and techniques (e.G., FTP, Postman, AWS Tools), and propose resolutions or workarounds.  What can you expect from us?  -  Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.  -  Opportunities to work outside Brazil  -  A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork. What do we offer? TCS Benefits – Brazil: Health insurance Dental Plan Life insurance Transportation vouchers Meal/Food Voucher Childcare assistance Gympass TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates Partnership with SESC Reimbursement of Certifications Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training International experience opportunity Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire TCS Gems – Recognition for performance Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform  At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions. Position Overview As a Backend Team Lead, you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable. Problem-Solving Skills:  Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions. Communication Skills:  Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Attention to Detail:  A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform. Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Conhecimentos desejáveis Experiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio;  Fluência em inglês;  Conhecimento emética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365. Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA. Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós. Acesse upx.Com para saber mais. Siga a UPX nas mídias sociais: Instagram BR | Instagram US | Threads BR | Threads US | TikTok (BR) | LinkedIn | YouTube | X | Reddit
